title: Dietary Supplementation of Auraptene, a Major Component in Citrus reticulata Blanco, Prevents Acute Liver Injury Associated with Apoptosis and Inflammation.
publicationName: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
journalName: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
snippet: Auraptene (AP), a coumarin derivative abundant in citrus peels, exhibits diverse bioactivities; however, its role in acute liver injury and the underlying mechanisms remain elusive.
